title: I'm developing Mission Nuts solo in Godot, with some help from AI – here's my 2D platform adventure!
author: Successful_Buy6579
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm Tom Sheol, a solo developer working on Mission Nuts, a colorful 2D action-platform adventure starring Wiewiu, a fearless little pink squirrel with a big personality! 🐿️🌰

I'm developing the game in Godot, and I mainly use AI tools to help create cutscenes and music. Everything is part of a much larger solo development process, from designing levels and gameplay mechanics to programming, testing and putting the whole adventure together.

Mission Nuts combines classic platforming, exploration, combat, hidden secrets, varied environments and boss fights, with a story about friendship, courage and hope.

There's already a free demo on Steam, featuring the first two short introductory levels. If you'd like to experience more, there's an extended playable build on itch.io.

🎮 [**itch.io**](http://itch.io) **(extended build):**  
[https://tomsheol.itch.io/mission-nuts](https://tomsheol.itch.io/mission-nuts)

🌰 **Steam (demo & wishlist):**  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5276180/Mission\_Nuts/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5276180/Mission_Nuts/)

The full game is planned for Q4 2027.

Thanks for checking it out! :)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/Successful_Buy6579, this falls under Rule 4. Commercial posts are okay here, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).
